children: DSS (DSS) shares retreated 33% on early Friday after Thursday's 54% jump, as investors weighed the company's latest move to raise capital through a common-stock offering.

The offering consists entirely of shares being sold by DSS, meaning the company would receive the proceeds rather than existing shareholders. The transaction remains subject to market conditions, and its final size and terms have not been determined.

DSS said it expects to direct the net proceeds toward general corporate requirements and working capital. The company operates across product packaging, biotechnology, commercial lending, securities and investment management, among other businesses.

The planned share sale adds a potential source of funding while also raising the prospect of additional share dilution for existing holders. Earlier filings show DSS has used equity offerings to support working capital and corporate purposes.
The financing could improve DSS's liquidity, but the potential increase in shares outstanding may weigh on investor sentiment.

title: DSS Shares Crash After Soaring. What the New Offering Means for Investors
